description: 8 MCP tools for exploring and downloading AI agent blueprints. List blueprints, get summaries, download full Agent Skills directories for implementation by coding agents. Vendor-agnostic output works with ServiceNow, Salesforce, OpenClaw, or any platform.

tool_signatures.name: DataParser
tool_signatures.description: Parses data

tool_signatures.name: TaskRouter
tool_signatures.description: Routes tasks

tool_signatures.name: TestRunner
tool_signatures.description: Runs tests

tool_signatures.name: create_business_profile
tool_signatures.description: Create or upsert a structured business profile for an existing organization. Use this first in the headless workflow: existing PAT + existing org -> create_business_profile -> generate_use_cases or trigger_full_pipeline.

fields.description: Structured business profile fields. Common keys: companyName, companyWebsite, industry, size, revenue, revenueUnit, currency, description, technology, capabilities, operations, constraints, strategicInitiatives.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Structured business profile fields. Common keys: companyName, companyWebsite, industry, size, revenue, revenueUnit, currency, description, technology, capabilities, operations, constraints, strategicInitiatives.

tool_signatures.name: download_blueprint
tool_signatures.description: Download a blueprint as an Agent Skills directory. Returns a JSON manifest with all files (SKILL.md, reference docs, scripts) that can be written to disk for any coding agent to consume. Use this instead of reading full blueprint/business-case/plan data via individual tools.

parameters.name: blueprintId
parameters.description: The blueprint ID (UUID)

tool_signatures.name: generate_blueprint
tool_signatures.description: Start blueprint generation for a chosen use case. This returns an auditId immediately; poll with get_generation_status until the blueprint is ready, then call download_blueprint.

useCaseId.description: The use case ID to turn into a blueprint.

guidanceText.description: Optional free-text guidance for the blueprint run.

guidance.description: Optional guidance array. If provided, the first string is used.

assumeMissing.description: If true, allows the generator to make reasonable assumptions when details are missing.

parameters.name: assumeMissing
parameters.description: If true, allows the generator to make reasonable assumptions when details are missing.

parameters.name: guidance
parameters.description: Optional guidance array. If provided, the first string is used.

parameters.name: guidanceText
parameters.description: Optional free-text guidance for the blueprint run.

parameters.name: useCaseId
parameters.description: The use case ID to turn into a blueprint.

tool_signatures.name: generate_use_cases
tool_signatures.description: Generate AI use cases from the current business profile and readiness assessment for an existing organization. Returns normalized use case data with IDs you can pass to generate_blueprint.

count.description: Optional number of use cases to generate (1-3).

guidanceText.description: Optional free-text guidance for the generation run.

guidance.description: Optional guidance array. If provided, the first string is used.

strategicInitiativeId.description: Optional strategic initiative ID to target.

parameters.name: additionalContext
parameters.description: Optional extra context (max 50,000 chars).

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Optional number of use cases to generate (1-3).

parameters.name: guidance
parameters.description: Optional guidance array. If provided, the first string is used.

parameters.name: guidanceText
parameters.description: Optional free-text guidance for the generation run.

parameters.name: strategicInitiativeId
parameters.description: Optional strategic initiative ID to target.

tool_signatures.name: get_blueprint
tool_signatures.description: Get a blueprint summary by ID. Returns title, executive summary, agentic pattern, platform, agent names/roles, and phase overview. For full details, use download_blueprint.

parameters.name: blueprintId
parameters.description: The blueprint ID (UUID)

tool_signatures.name: get_business_case
tool_signatures.description: Get a business case summary for a blueprint. Returns executive summary, headline ROI numbers, pilot economics, and recommendation. For full financial analysis, use download_blueprint.

parameters.name: blueprintId
parameters.description: The blueprint ID (UUID)

tool_signatures.name: get_business_profile
tool_signatures.description: Get the business profile for the organization. Returns company details, industry, strategic initiatives, technology profile, and AI readiness score.

tool_signatures.name: get_generation_status
tool_signatures.description: Poll either blueprint generation or full-pipeline generation status. Pass exactly one of auditId or jobId. When the run finishes with a blueprintId, call download_blueprint.

auditId.description: Blueprint generation audit ID returned by generate_blueprint.

jobId.description: Full-pipeline job ID returned by trigger_full_pipeline.

parameters.name: auditId
parameters.description: Blueprint generation audit ID returned by generate_blueprint.

parameters.name: jobId
parameters.description: Full-pipeline job ID returned by trigger_full_pipeline.

tool_signatures.name: get_implementation_plan
tool_signatures.description: Get an implementation plan summary for a blueprint. Returns project overview, epic names with phases and story counts, and timeline. For full stories and dependencies, use download_blueprint.

parameters.name: blueprintId
parameters.description: The blueprint ID (UUID)

tool_signatures.name: get_implementation_spec
tool_signatures.description: Get the compiled implementation spec for a blueprint. Returns metadata about the spec package including agent count, platform, and what artifacts are included.

parameters.name: blueprintId
parameters.description: The blueprint ID (UUID)

tool_signatures.name: get_progress
tool_signatures.description: Get implementation progress and performance metrics for a blueprint. Returns predicted targets, latest actual measurements with deviation analysis, and implementation state (if synced via sync_implementation_state). Use this to check how an implementation is tracking against the plan.

parameters.name: blueprintId
parameters.description: The blueprint ID (UUID)

tool_signatures.name: get_recommendations
tool_signatures.description: Get strategic recommendations for a blueprint based on implementation state, performance metrics, and AI landscape changes. Returns prioritized, actionable recommendations. Requires implementation state to be synced first via sync_implementation_state. Use ?force=true to regenerate.

parameters.name: blueprintId
parameters.description: The blueprint ID (UUID)

tool_signatures.name: get_use_case
tool_signatures.description: Get the use case analysis linked to a blueprint. Returns business challenge, success metrics, ROI estimate, and strategic alignment.

parameters.name: blueprintId
parameters.description: The blueprint ID (UUID)

tool_signatures.name: list_blueprints
tool_signatures.description: List all blueprints for the organization. Returns summaries with id, title, platform, agent count, and lifecycle status.

tool_signatures.name: recalculate_financials
tool_signatures.description: Recalculate business case financials from current blueprint and profile data. Use this after updating the blueprint to refresh ROI projections, labor savings, and payback period. Clears staleness on the business case.

parameters.name: blueprintId
parameters.description: The blueprint ID (UUID)

tool_signatures.name: report_metric
tool_signatures.description: Report actual performance metrics for a blueprint. The system auto-resolves predicted targets from the blueprint and returns deviation analysis. Supports multiple metrics in one call. Use this after implementing agents to track whether they hit their success criteria.

metricType.description: Metric category. Auto-detected from blueprint if omitted.

baselineValue.description: Pre-agent baseline value, if this is the first measurement

notes.description: Context about how the measurement was taken

measuredAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when measured. Defaults to now.

metrics.description: One or more metrics to report

parameters.name: blueprintId
parameters.description: The blueprint ID (UUID)

parameters.name: metrics
parameters.description: One or more metrics to report

metricType.description: Metric category. Auto-detected from blueprint if omitted.

baselineValue.description: Pre-agent baseline value, if this is the first measurement

notes.description: Context about how the measurement was taken

measuredAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when measured. Defaults to now.

tool_signatures.name: sync_implementation_state
tool_signatures.description: Sync implementation state back to Agent Blueprint. Reports which agents have been implemented, their status, platform artifacts, and any deviations from the spec. Each sync creates a versioned snapshot enabling progress tracking over time.

stateData.description: Implementation state data (structured JSON matching implementation-state.yaml schema)

parameters.name: blueprintId
parameters.description: The blueprint ID (UUID)

parameters.name: stateData
parameters.description: Implementation state data (structured JSON matching implementation-state.yaml schema)

tool_signatures.name: trigger_full_pipeline
tool_signatures.description: Start the full pipeline for an existing business profile. This runs use cases through implementation plan generation asynchronously and returns a jobId; poll with get_generation_status.

businessProfileId.description: The business profile ID to run through the pipeline.

specialInstructions.description: Optional execution guidance for downstream generations.

strategicInitiativeId.description: Optional strategic initiative ID to bias use-case selection.

parameters.name: businessProfileId
parameters.description: The business profile ID to run through the pipeline.

parameters.name: specialInstructions
parameters.description: Optional execution guidance for downstream generations.

parameters.name: strategicInitiativeId
parameters.description: Optional strategic initiative ID to bias use-case selection.

tool_signatures.name: update_blueprint
tool_signatures.description: Update blueprint sections with actual implementation data. Sends full top-level sections that are shallow-merged into the existing blueprint. Creates a version snapshot before mutation and propagates staleness to business case and implementation plan. Use this when the implementation diverges from the original recommendation.

sections.description: Top-level sections to merge. Common keys: enhancedDigitalTeam, phases, executiveSummary, executiveSummaryDetails, platformRecommendation, agenticPattern, riskAssessment, successCriteria, feasibilityIndicators, laborAnalysis, title, blueprintTitle, roiBaseline, howItWorks, teams, kpis, digitalTeam, implementation, dataProvenance, architectureRationale, integrationGaps, customTables. Additional keys are accepted and preserved.

parameters.name: blueprintId
parameters.description: The blueprint ID (UUID)

parameters.name: sections
parameters.description: Top-level sections to merge. Common keys: enhancedDigitalTeam, phases, executiveSummary, executiveSummaryDetails, platformRecommendation, agenticPattern, riskAssessment, successCriteria, feasibilityIndicators, laborAnalysis, title, blueprintTitle, roiBaseline, howItWorks, teams, kpis, digitalTeam, implementation, dataProvenance, architectureRationale, integrationGaps, customTables. Additional keys are accepted and preserved.

tool_signatures.name: update_business_case
tool_signatures.description: Update business case sections. Shallow-merges provided sections into the existing business case data. Propagates staleness to implementation plan. After updating, consider calling recalculate_financials to refresh ROI projections.

sections.description: Top-level sections to merge. Common keys: executiveSummary, businessContext, objectives, proposedSolution, benefits, risks, recommendation. Additional keys are accepted and preserved.

parameters.name: blueprintId
parameters.description: The blueprint ID (UUID)

parameters.name: sections
parameters.description: Top-level sections to merge. Common keys: executiveSummary, businessContext, objectives, proposedSolution, benefits, risks, recommendation. Additional keys are accepted and preserved.

tool_signatures.name: update_business_profile
tool_signatures.description: Update business profile fields. Updates company details, technology profile, strategic initiatives, etc. Propagates staleness to use cases. Also syncs company name to the organization record.

fields.description: Fields to update. Valid keys: companyName, industry, size, revenue, currency, description, companyWebsite, technology, capabilities, operations, constraints, strategicInitiatives

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Fields to update. Valid keys: companyName, industry, size, revenue, currency, description, companyWebsite, technology, capabilities, operations, constraints, strategicInitiatives

tool_signatures.name: update_implementation_plan
tool_signatures.description: Update implementation plan sections. Shallow-merges provided sections into the existing plan. This is a terminal artifact with no downstream staleness propagation.

sections.description: Top-level sections to merge. Common keys: projectOverview, epics, dependencies, resources, risks, agentSpecifications. Additional keys are accepted and preserved.

parameters.name: blueprintId
parameters.description: The blueprint ID (UUID)

parameters.name: sections
parameters.description: Top-level sections to merge. Common keys: projectOverview, epics, dependencies, resources, risks, agentSpecifications. Additional keys are accepted and preserved.

tool_signatures.name: update_use_case
tool_signatures.description: Update use case fields for a blueprint. Updates the use case linked to the specified blueprint. Propagates staleness to the blueprint.

Common keys: title, description, businessChallenge, description5Ws, currentPainPoints, desiredBusinessOutcomes, processDocumentation, transformationStory, typedSuccessMetrics, organizationalConstraints, affectedDepartments. Unknown keys are accepted but only mapped fields are persisted.
